strategy_lineage: prospective factor shadows on frozen nfci-dual-core-v11
hypothesis: At least one historically exposed but not robust-certified factor will show genuine incremental timing value on new post-freeze data when tracked prospectively without any parameter changes.
allowed_changes: append-only prospective snapshots using new market/factor data after the freeze date
mechanical realized-NAV accounting from already-recorded shadow targets and frozen 1.00% fee + 0.05% slippage
operational bug fixes that do not change candidate rules, with old records preserved
forbidden_changes: changing any frozen V11 rule or target path
changing F-CREDITCASH completion gross target from 100%
changing HYG/SHY, RSP/SPY or SPHB/SPLV sources
adding a fourth candidate to this trial
recomputing or overwriting an old prospective snapshot after future outcomes are known
using factor observations later than the V11 signal_date
selecting a winner before the frozen evaluation milestone
selection_metric: No candidate selection before 504 new sessions. Each candidate is assessed independently against frozen V11 and its own matched control; 252 sessions is provisional only.
pass_fail_gates: <63 sessions: integrity only, no performance conclusion
252 sessions: provisional assessment only; low eligible-event count is INCONCLUSIVE
504 sessions: at least 8 factor-available eligible V11 events
504 sessions: candidate net annualized return > V11 shadow
504 sessions: candidate realized Sharpe >= V11 shadow Sharpe
504 sessions: candidate realized Sharpe > own matched-control Sharpe
gross <=100%, no shorting, no financing, no negative cash throughout
follow_up_policy: Do not tune or replace these candidates using prospective results. Any new factor hypothesis requires a new trial and a new freeze date. A 504-session low-event result is INCONCLUSIVE rather than a license to alter thresholds.
swift_engine_entrypoint: Frozen V11 PublicBacktestCore forward snapshot + tools/orthogonal_event_factor_v3_logic.swift + tools/orthogonal_factor_family_v1_logic.swift; prospective factor state/targets are appended by a separate research-shadow runner and are not production strategy IDs.
expected_outputs: V11 signal/execution metadata and target fingerprint for every snapshot
recent raw factor inputs and SHA-256 manifests
factor latest/prior observations and risk-on state
eligible/de-risk/intervention flags and persistent prior state
realized net NAV/return/Sharpe/MDD summaries at frozen milestones

F-CREDITCASH-PROSPECTIVE.event_scope: V11 rebalance event with 0 < positive gross < 1
F-CREDITCASH-PROSPECTIVE.risk_on_rule: latest usable common-date ratio >= ratio 20 common observations earlier
F-CREDITCASH-PROSPECTIVE.action: proportionally complete current positive V11 holdings to exactly 100% gross

F-BREADTH-PROSPECTIVE.event_scope: V11 rebalance event that is a de-risk event versus the previous V11 rebalance-event base target
F-BREADTH-PROSPECTIVE.risk_on_rule: latest usable common-date ratio >= ratio 20 common observations earlier
F-BREADTH-PROSPECTIVE.action: retain exactly 50% of each current event reduction, gross cap 100%
F-BREADTH-PROSPECTIVE.matched_control: retain 50% on every factor-available de-risk event

F-HIGHBETA-PROSPECTIVE.event_scope: V11 rebalance event that is a de-risk event versus the previous V11 rebalance-event base target
F-HIGHBETA-PROSPECTIVE.risk_on_rule: latest usable common-date ratio >= ratio 20 common observations earlier
F-HIGHBETA-PROSPECTIVE.action: retain exactly 50% of each current event reduction, gross cap 100%
F-HIGHBETA-PROSPECTIVE.matched_control: retain 50% on every factor-available de-risk event
